articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Bitcoin-backed loans belong in the cost-of-capital conversation
articles.snippet: In this week’s Crypto Long & Short Newsletter, Alec Beckman on why BTC-backed lending is not a crypto story, but a capital efficiency story. Then, Serena Sebastiani on how stablecoins aren’t a crypto product; they’re becoming the settlement infrastructure global finance forgot.

articles.title: Crypto campaign cash from Fairshake flooded Southern primaries, picked winners
articles.snippet: The leading industry super PAC claimed a "6-0 sweep" in the primaries in Kentucky, Alabama and Georgia, though one big race awaits a runoff.

articles.title: Raoul Pal says AI and crypto are reshaping the global economy faster than most think
articles.snippet: The Real Vision founder said that humanity is entering an “exponential age” where AI, crypto and tokenization could rewrite finance, labor and culture.

articles.title: Too many cooks: How regulatory infighting is choking the UK's crypto hub ambitions
articles.snippet: While the FCA opens its doors to market pilots, structural delays and legislative friction are fueling industry frustration over a framework trailing behind the U.S. and Europe.

articles.title: Despite Trump’s pledge, a CBDC is being explored behind closed doors, says former CTFC chair
articles.snippet: Publicly, the U.S. has fiercely opposed a Central Bank Digital Currency, but former CFTC Chairman Timothy Massad said it is inevitable and there will be one sooner or later.
